strategies.summary: If London fails to reach the higher-timeframe PD array, wait for New York to reach it and reverse from there. Enter on the retracement into the new bullish overlap that forms after the New York displacement.

timeframes.notes: Fractal session model. Use 15m to read the London/New York handoff; execute on 5m with 4h-or-higher context, or on 1m with 1h context.

glossary.Suffocating the stop loss: Placing the stop at the intraday low while an unfilled 15m or 1h fair value gap still sits below it, giving price a structural reason to revisit the area.

custom_signals.name: htf_pd_array_tap
custom_signals.plain_definition: Price trades into a higher-timeframe discount array (bullish) or premium array (bearish), such as a fair value gap or order block.
custom_signals.numeric_definition: (low <= bullish_fvg[0].gap_high@bias_tf AND high >= bullish_fvg[0].gap_low@bias_tf AND NOT bullish_fvg[0].filled@bias_tf) OR (low <= bullish_ob[0].zone_high@bias_tf AND high >= bullish_ob[0].zone_low@bias_tf AND NOT bullish_ob[0].invalidated@bias_tf)

custom_signals.name: first_fvg_after_array_tap
custom_signals.plain_definition: The very first fair value gap that forms in the trade direction after price taps the higher-timeframe PD array.
custom_signals.numeric_definition: bullish_fvg[0].formed AND any(custom_signals.htf_pd_array_tap, K_TAP_LOOKBACK_CANDLES) AND count(bullish_fvg[0].formed, K_TAP_LOOKBACK_CANDLES) == 1

custom_signals.name: london_missed_htf_poi
custom_signals.plain_definition: The London session fails to tap the intended higher-timeframe PD array objective.
custom_signals.numeric_definition: kill_zone == new_york_am AND count(custom_signals.htf_pd_array_tap AND kill_zone == london, ny_minute / tf_minutes + 1) == 0

custom_signals.name: ny_taps_htf_poi
custom_signals.plain_definition: The New York session reaches the higher-timeframe PD array, completing the objective London missed.

custom_signals.name: overlapping_pd_array
custom_signals.plain_definition: A fair value gap that shares price with another PD array (order block) on the same timeframe; the shared range is the entry zone.
custom_signals.numeric_definition: max(bullish_fvg[0].gap_low, bullish_ob[0].zone_low) <= min(bullish_fvg[0].gap_high, bullish_ob[0].zone_high) AND NOT bullish_fvg[0].filled AND NOT bullish_ob[0].invalidated

custom_signals.name: intermediate_term_low
custom_signals.plain_definition: A swing low flanked by a higher swing low on its left and a higher swing low on its right.

custom_signals.name: london_taps_htf_poi_and_displaces
custom_signals.plain_definition: The London session reaches the higher-timeframe PD array and displaces in the intended trend direction.
custom_signals.numeric_definition: kill_zone == new_york_am AND count(custom_signals.first_fvg_after_array_tap AND kill_zone == london, ny_minute / tf_minutes + 1) >= 1

sequence: Confirm that London missed the higher-timeframe array.
Wait for New York to trade into that array.
Mark the new bullish fair value gap that starts the reversal leg.
Enter on the retracement into the new overlapping bullish PD array.

invalidation.text: If London already tapped the HTF PD array and displaced, this exact setup is invalid and shifts to a New York Retracement.

filters.text: Check intermediate timeframes (e.g., 15m and 1H) to ensure you are not suffocating your stop loss.
filters.numeric_definition: NOT ((NOT bullish_fvg[0].filled@15m AND bullish_fvg[0].gap_low@15m < custom_signals.intermediate_term_low) OR (NOT bullish_fvg[0].filled@1h AND bullish_fvg[0].gap_low@1h < custom_signals.intermediate_term_low))

filters.text: On Mondays, aim for lower RR, high probability targets to build confidence for the week.

entry_rule.text: Enter on the retracement into the first overlapping bullish order-block / fair-value-gap zone created by the New York reversal leg.
entry_rule.quote: we enter off of that order block where we also have that fair value Gap

target_rule.text: Target the opposing bias-timeframe swing high / premium array the New York reversal is drawing toward.
target_rule.quote: the first Target is intermediate term High aka the opposing premium Ray on a four hour basis

stop_rule.text: Place the stop beyond the New York intermediate-term low after checking that no unfilled 15m or 1h fair value gap still sits below it.
stop_rule.quote: we can place our stop loss at that five minute low that we had right there

management.notes: Keep targets extremely conservative on Mondays.

setup_walkthrough.what_happens: Establishes a bullish context across Monthly, Daily, and 4H timeframes, identifying a 4H FVG inside a Daily OB.
Observes that the London session formed a low but missed the 4H FVG.
In New York, price sweeps lower into the 4H FVG, forming the low of the day.
Price displaces higher on the 5m, creating an ST model. A 5m overlapping PD array (OB + FVG) forms.
Entry is taken on the retracement into the 5m overlapping OB + FVG. Stop is placed below the 5m intermediate term low after checking 15m context to avoid suffocating it.
